message.reasoning: We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "Is the invoice date the same as when we first signed up, or does it shift each month?" This is about invoice date behavior. The policy says: monthly plan is invoiced on same day of month as workspace's original billing date — the date subscription started or last renewed. Also says date shown in Settings → Billing → Plan next to “Next invoice”, does not shift month to month even though months have different lengths; a billing date of the 31st bills on the last day of a shorter month. So answer: invoice date stays same as original billing date, does not shift; if original date is 31st, then shorter months bill on last day. Provide short answer. No need to escalate. Use post_reply.
